question: Was Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green ground for noise, and when?
norm_question: was liverpool street to bethnal green ground for noise and when

answer.text: In Mayor's Question 2022/1791, Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street on the Central line is listed as having benefited from rail grinding to help reduce noise levels between December 2021 and May 2022, while Liverpool Street to Bethnal Green Eastbound was also planned for deep Tube reconditioning in financial year 2023/24.

verified_claims.text: In Mayor's Question 2022/1791 (28 June 2022), Bethnal Green to Liverpool Street on the Central line is listed among the sections that benefited from rail grinding to help reduce noise levels between December 2021 and May 2022.
